verdicts.reason: Both drop the woman-in-wind photo, which was the key image, and leave only a washed-out sky. In both, the -Helen Keller attribution is pushed to a cramped two-line scrap off to the side of the quote. A: the logo is oversized and the Huzzah/Since 1982 labels butt against its right edge, but the tagline and address form a tidy column and the quote reads clearly. B: the tiny logo collides with Huzzah beneath it, and Since 1982, the tagline and the address are scattered along a bottom row jammed near the edge. Its attribution is also crushed against the right edge, so it reads as fragments rather than a composed banner.
